questions.q: Which muscle is the antagonist to the quadriceps when the knee extends?
questions.why: The hamstrings relax while the quadriceps contract; they are the antagonistic pair at the knee.

questions.q: A gymnast holds a still handstand. Which type of contraction do her shoulder muscles perform?
questions.why: The muscle contracts without changing length, so there is no movement: isometric.

questions.q: Which statement about fast twitch fibres is correct?
options: They fatigue slowly and use aerobic energy
They produce high force but fatigue quickly
They produce low force and fatigue quickly
They are best for marathon running
questions.why: Fast twitch fibres give high force, use anaerobic energy and fatigue quickly.

questions.q: Explain how the biceps and triceps work as an antagonistic pair when the elbow bends.
questions.model: The biceps is the agonist and contracts, pulling on the forearm bone through its tendon to bend the elbow. The triceps is the antagonist and relaxes to allow the movement.
points: Biceps contract (agonist/prime mover) to flex the elbow
